**`@click`**

_Vue event listener_

Shorthand for `v-on:event`. The handler runs in component scope.

**Example**

```vue
<template>
  <button @click="handler"></button>
</template>
```

**Docs**

[Vue event handling](https://vuejs.org/guide/essentials/event-handling.html)
